correctness.rationale: At size t the sum of the outdegrees is t−1, hence the total weight is D_t=t+a(t−1). Given the activation history, each eligible nonroot label has probability 1/D_t; the root is already ineligible at size two and the newborn enters as a leaf. Per step an independent proposal of each nonroot label with probability 1/[a(t−1)] followed by acceptance at rate a(t−1)/D_t for eligible labels exactly reproduces this complete history. The rejection probability is t/(aD_t)+(H_t−1)/D_t with H_t the number of already active vertices including the root. The expectation of H_t−1 is at most (t−2)/a, by counting all earlier positive proposals. The two numerators sum in expectation to at most 2(t−1) over a common denominator aD_t, yielding 2/a² per step, even at t=2; for n=2 the two empty histories agree. This is a total-variation bound on the labelled joint law, not just the count law. In the stated triangular array n/a_n² tends to zero. Taking logs of the independent reference Laplace functional incurs an O(n/a_n²) error, and the mark inside each time slice is uniform on the label grid j/t. The grid Riemann sums converge uniformly away from t/n=0; the bounded integrand and the vanishing relative fraction of early times complete the limit on the compact square including λ=0. The root-star event is exactly zero nonroot activations and its reference probability is (1−1/a_n)^(n−2). The source VERIFICATION.md, checker.py and checker_output.txt were inspected without execution; the reported exact finite checks are source evidence, not independent execution or a certificate of the limit.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The seed difference can be bridged. Start the undirected affine model with a ghost leaf joined to the root, use c=a and d=1−a, and condition the ghost to remain a leaf through the observation horizon. At real size t after the root has acquired its first real child, every real vertex has ordinary degree outdegree+1, and the full normalizer is D_t+1. Ghost survival excludes exactly its proposal at each step under the exact leaf-set construction; the conditional nonroot proposal probability is 1/D_t. At real size one the first real attachment is forced by that conditioning. Thus this comparison accounts for the exact eligible-label dynamics and the latent independent proposals, but those proposals have a different rate from the independent reference stated in the finding and only first proposals generate activations.

value.rationale: A quantitative approximation for the full finite birth-labelled experiment is useful for arbitrary joint first-parent queries and need not reconstruct the reinforced tree. Its vanishing-error range a≫√n is broader than the fixed finite-intensity critical window; the critical limit then gives the interpretable independent fractional birth labels and event times. The finite-survival formula and zero-event limit in isolation would support a much smaller contribution.
